templates.name: RFQ received – marine
templates.subject: We received your RFQ {{customerRef}} — {{vessel}} ({{caseId}})
templates.body:
Dear {{contact}},

Thank you for your request for {{vessel}} at {{port}}. It is registered with us as {{caseId}} (your reference {{customerRef}}), and {{owner}} is looking after it.

We will send our quotation by {{dueAt}}. If anything changes on board — quantities, ETA or delivery point — simply reply to this email and it will reach the same case.

Kind regards,
{{owner}}
Golden Sea for Trading & Marketing
Ship chandlers · Port Said · Suez · Alexandria · Damietta
24/7 for urgent requests: +20 3 000 0000
templates.bodyAr:
السيد/ة {{contact}}،

نشكركم على طلبكم الخاص بالسفينة {{vessel}} في ميناء {{port}}. تم تسجيله لدينا برقم {{caseId}} (مرجعكم {{customerRef}})، ويتابعه {{owner}}.

سنرسل عرض السعر قبل {{dueAt}}. لأي تغيير في الكميات أو موعد الوصول أو مكان التسليم، يكفي الرد على هذه الرسالة.

مع خالص التحية،
{{owner}}
جولدن سي للتجارة والتسويق
تموين السفن · بورسعيد · السويس · الإسكندرية · دمياط

templates.name: Supplier RFQ (anonymised)
templates.subject: Request for quotation {{reference}} — reply by {{dueAt}}
templates.body:
Dear {{supplierContact}},

Please quote the following lines, delivered to our {{warehouse}} warehouse:
{{lines}}

Please state unit price and currency, pack size, lead time, validity, payment terms and include SDS / TDS where applicable.

Kind regards,
{{user}}
Golden Sea purchasing

templates.body:

{{user}}
